title: Saying Goodbye
prompt: What do you say when you leave?
hint: Use the short goodbye phrase from the sample — two words.

ja.prompt: 出るときは何と言いますか？
ja.hint: サンプルにある短い別れのフレーズ（2語）を使ってください。

local.hint: 說出範例裡的兩個字的再見用語。

local_pron.prompt: Líkāi shí nǐ huì shuō shénme?
local_pron.hint: Shuō chū fànlì lǐ de liǎng gè zì de zàijiàn yòngyǔ.

zh.hint: 說出範例裡的兩個字的再見用語。

en.prompt: What do you say when you leave?
en.hint: Use the short goodbye phrase from the sample — two words.

en_pron.prompt: Wut doo yoo say when yoo leev?
en_pron.hint: Use the short goodbye phrase from the sample — two words.

title: Waving Hand
prompt: What do you do with your hand?
hint: Name the action from the instructions: move your hand to say goodbye.

ja.hint: 指示にある、別れを伝えるための手の動きを言ってください。

local.hint: 說出指示中的動作：用手動作來說再見。

local_pron.prompt: Nǐ huì yòng shǒu zuò shénme?
local_pron.hint: Shuō chū zhǐshì zhōng de dòngzuò: yòng shǒu dòngzuò lái shuō zàijiàn.

zh.hint: 說出指示中的動作：用手動作來說再見。

en.hint: Name the action from the instructions: move your hand to say goodbye.

en_pron.prompt: Wut doo yoo doo with yor hand?
en_pron.hint: Name the action from the instructions: move your hand to say goodbye.

title: Jumping and Hopping Count
prompt: How many times do you jump and hop?
hint: Look at the 'Jumping and Hopping' instruction: count jumps then hops.
sample: Jump six times and hop eight times.

ja.prompt: 何回ジャンプして何回ホップしますか？
ja.hint: 「ジャンプとホップ」の指示を見て、ジャンプの回数とホップの回数を答えてください。
ja.sample: ジャンプを6回して、ホップを8回します。

local.prompt: 你要跳幾次和單腳跳幾次？
local.hint: 看「跳與單腳跳」的指示：先數跳的次數，再數單腳跳的次數。
local.sample: Jump six times and hop eight times.

local_pron.prompt: Nǐ yào tiào jǐ cì hé dān jiǎo tiào jǐ cì?
local_pron.hint: Kàn 'tiào yǔ dān jiǎo tiào' de zhǐshì: xiān shǔ tiào de cìshù, ránhòu shǔ dān jiǎo tiào de cìshù.
local_pron.sample: Jump six times and hop eight times.

zh.prompt: 你要跳幾次和單腳跳幾次？
zh.hint: 看「跳和單腳跳」的指示：先數跳的次數，再數單腳跳的次數。
zh.sample: Jump six times and hop eight times.

en.prompt: How many times do you jump and hop?
en.hint: Look at the 'Jumping and Hopping' instruction: count jumps then hops.
en.sample: Jump six times and hop eight times.

en_pron.prompt: How many tymz doo yoo jump and hop?
en_pron.hint: Look at the 'Jumping and Hopping' instruction: count jumps then hops.
